messages:
nadia: planning a short maintenance window tonight 00:15-01:00 UTC. scope: controlled cordon+reboot of 6 GPU nodes in az2 (gpu-pool-d[8-13]). reason: validate new kernel io-scheduler tweak after intermittent nvme tail latency. we'll do 2-node cohorts to keep pressure low.

ben: what's our backfill and routing plan? any cross-region implications?

nadia: backfill: prefer local warm racks in az2, then az1 if needed. routing: keep az2 primary but raise scoring for warm racks to absorb burst. cross-region egress should be minimal because we avoid shifting user traffic to eu/us unless unavoidable.

frank: capacity check? I don't want scheduled jobs preempted mid-run.

nadia: cluster-sim shows ~20% headroom after pausing best-effort batch jobs. we've scheduled batch blackout for the 45m window.

Link in runbook: https://go/runbooks/infra/az2-io-check (internal).

lia: customer impact? Dedicated customers?

nadia: no impact expected for Dedicated/Reserved racks. Affects spot/intermittent only. we'll post a short note to #support-ops to monitor `gpu.latency.p95` and `nvme.io.ms`.

ben: paste exact commands for audit.

nadia: flow: `kubectl cordon $NODE && kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m` -> `ssh $NODE sudo sysctl -w block/iosched=kyber` -> `sudo reboot` -> post boot run `curl -sS https://internal-prewarm/prefix -d '{"pool":"gpu"}'` and wait for `cache.prefix.ready` metric.

frank: gate times? if prewarm takes long we should pause.

nadia: gate: 4m for prefix warm. if >4m on two consecutive nodes, pause window and roll back. we also added a rollback: revert iosched to previous and mark node for deeper diagnostic.

infra-bot: scheduled by nadia: az2-io-sanity @ 2026-05-10T00:15:00Z -> 2026-05-10T01:00:00Z. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/infra/az2-io-check. Pager duty: infra-oncall.

ben: cost hit? moving workloads to warm racks could increase billed reserved hours slightly.

nadia: estimate ~0.3% extra GPU-hours for the hour; finance signed off. noted in runbook.

lia: please draft the customer blurb: I'll post 30m before.

nadia: suggested blurb: "No service interruption expected for Reserved customers. Intermittent pools may see brief scheduling delays while we validate a kernel IO tweak."

frank: can we capture lightweight dmesg and a short nvme stat snapshot during reboots for correlation?

nadia: yes capturing: `dmesg -T > /tmp/dmesg-$(hostname).log` and `nvme list && nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1 > /tmp/nvme-$(hostname).log` compressed and uploaded to s3 runbook bucket. keep traces <10MB.

ben: I'll be on-call for mitigation, lia will handle comms, nadia+frank execute.

infra-bot: nadia started maintenance: az2-io-sanity at 2026-05-10T00:15:00Z (scheduled run).

nadia: kicking cohort 1 (d8-d9) in ~2m. leaving thread open for live notes.
